Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MMC.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $6.90 per share.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 24% to 21% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2023.
Our cloud segment grew 24% year-over-year, driven by strong enterprise demand.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 711 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Second question - Analyst:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
